operation.summary: What's switched on and ready, and why not
operation.returns: per capability: title, enabled (the phone switch), ready (the device can do it), agent_allowed (the owner lets you use it), blocked_reason, details. Usable only when agent_allowed, enabled and ready are all true. enabled false means the owner's switch is off; blocked_reason names other known causes (agent_not_allowed, a missing Android permission, no_hardware) and can be null. Also notifications, callback {set, host}, listener
